title: Google’s best Pixel case in years still isn’t good enough to forget the fabric ones [Gallery]
summary: One of my favorite things about the first few generations of Pixel were Google’s official cases, but that’s not been true in recent years. I truly wish Google would copy exactly this and give it to the rest of the Pixel lineup.
